## Exploring Donor Metadata

```{r}

glimpse(donor_metadata)
```
```{r}

  count(sex, sort = TRUE)
```


## Exploring RNA-Seq Data

```{r}
#| eval: false

# (Teo's code)

# 1. Initial exploration of the data
View(fpkm_normalized)
str(fpkm_normalized)
summary(fpkm_normalized)

is.na(fpkm_normalized)

# 2. Preparing the data to expand it 

fpkm_t <- fpkm_normalized |> 
  rename(gene_id = 1) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_id,
    names_to = "rnaseq_profile_id",
    values_to = "fpkm"
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gene_id,
    values_from = fpkm
  )
```


```{r}
rnaseq_data <- read_csv(here("data/_raw/fpkm_table_normalized.csv.gz"))

dim(rnaseq_data)
```

```{r}
glimpse(rnaseq_data[, 1:6]) #there are 378 cols, lets not print them all
```

```{r}
# Inspect a subset of sample columns in long format to check distribution and missingness:

sample_cols <- names(rnaseq_data)[-1]

rnaseq_data |>
  select(1, all_of(head(sample_cols, 5))) |>
  pivot_longer(-1, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "fpkm_norm") |>
  group_by(sample_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_genes = n(),
    n_na = sum(is.na(fpkm_norm)),
    min_val = min(fpkm_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_val = median(fpkm_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_val = max(fpkm_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
